quote: Evaluation metrics. In the evaluation stage of link prediction, we ignore other potentially correct tails of the test samples (h, r, ?) in the training set, validation set, and test set, based on the filtered strategy. We then determine the ranking of the correct tail entity among all candidate entities. In our study, we use the softmax value from classifier as score to rank entities. The obtained rank will be used to calculate the following evaluation metrics: Mean Rank (MR), Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR), and Hits@K.
